title: Terrible Toothache
question: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?

meanings.usage: 形容疼痛或情况非常严重
通常与have连用，如have a toothache
指治疗牙齿问题的医生
通常用have an appointment表示预约
形容需要立即处理的事情
形容身体或感觉非常不舒服
指中午到傍晚之间的时间

examples.en: I have a terrible toothache.
I want to see the dentist, please.
Do you have an appointment?
Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday?
examples.zh: 您能星期一上午10点来吗？

phrases.usage: 表示恐怕...（礼貌地表达不好的消息）

examples.en: I'm afraid that he can't.
Can't you wait till this afternoon?
The dentist is very busy at the moment.
I feel awful.

sentences.en: I want to see the dentist, please.
Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
sentences.zh: 你能在4月24日星期一上午10点来吗？

sentences.en: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
sentences.zh: 护士，我必须现在就看牙医。

sentences.en: The dentist is very busy at the moment.
Can the dentist see me now?
sentences.zh: 牙医现在能给我看病吗？

sentences.en: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
sentences.zh: 克罗夫特先生，恐怕他不能。

sentences.en: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
sentences.zh: 你不能等到今天下午吗？

sentences.en: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
sentences.zh: 我能等，但我的牙痛不能等！

grammar.title: 情态动词 can 和 can't 的用法
grammar.definition: can表示能力或可能性，can't表示不能或不允许
grammar.structure: 主语 + can/can't + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于询问或陈述能力、请求许可、表达可能性。疑问句将can提前。

examples.en: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday?
examples.zh: 您能星期一上午10点来吗？

examples.en: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
The dentist can't see me now.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时
grammar.definition: 一般现在时描述习惯性动作，现在进行时描述正在发生的动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词原形/动词+s / 主语 + am/is/are + 动词-ing
grammar.usage: 一般现在时用于经常性的动作，现在进行时用于正在进行的动作

examples.en: Do you have an appointment?
The dentist is very busy at the moment.

grammar.title: 一般过去时
grammar.definition: 描述过去发生的动作或存在的状态
grammar.usage: 用于叙述过去发生的事情

examples.en: Good morning, Mr. Croft.

patterns.pattern: Can you come at + 时间?

original.en: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
original.zh: 您能4月24日星期一上午10点来吗？

examples.en: Can you come at 3 p.m. tomorrow?
Can you come at 9 o'clock?

patterns.pattern: I want to see the + 职业, please.

original.en: I want to see the dentist, please.

examples.en: I want to see the doctor, please.
I want to see the manager, please.

original.en: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.

examples.en: I'm afraid that she isn't here.
I'm afraid that the shop is closed.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + can't wait, but + 主语 + can't (either).

original.en: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
original.zh: 我能等，但我的牙疼不能等！

examples.en: I can work, but my computer can't!
examples.zh: 我能工作，但我的电脑不能！
